arrive.text: A village feast. One cake, eight slices, and you're doing the serving.

monster.text: At the head of the table sits the monster. Cake makes it far happier than it makes anyone else. A hundred times happier, every bite.

meter.text: That meter adds up everyone's happiness.

meter_2.text: The meter doesn't care who is happy. Only how much happiness there is, all added up.

ask.text: If the right thing is whatever makes the most happiness in total, who should get the cake?

hungry.text: The villagers are watching the monster eat.

end_monster.text: Every slice went to the monster. The most happiness there could be. And six people went without.

end_shared.text: You shared it out. Less happiness, added up. But everyone had some.

end_mixed.text: Some for the monster, some for the village.

end.text: Add up happiness, and the monster should get everything. Most people feel something has gone wrong in the adding.
